tasks.title: Benchmark Baseline — Establish Performance Baseline on Intel Arc Pro B60
tasks.description: Run comprehensive benchmarks of all SYCL kernels on the target hardware (Intel Arc Pro B60) BEFORE any optimizations. This establishes the baseline against which all subsequent optimizations will be measured. Without a baseline, it's impossible to quantify improvement or detect regressions.
actions: Build llama.cpp with SYCL backend for Intel Arc Pro B60 (cmake -DGGML_SYCL=ON -DGGML_SYCL_TARGET=INTEL)
Run llama-bench with representative models: (1) small model (TinyLlama-1.1B Q4_0), (2) medium model (Llama-2-7B Q4_0, Q4_K_M, Q8_0), (3) large model (Llama-2-13B Q4_0 if VRAM permits)
For each model, measure: prompt processing (pp512), token generation (tg128), batch sizes (1, 4, 8)
Run ggml-sycl microbenchmarks if available, or create targeted kernel benchmarks for hot-path kernels (MMQ, MMVQ, DMMV, softmax, rope, norm, binbcast)
Record per-kernel timing using SYCL profiling events (queue property: sycl::property::queue::enable_profiling())
Save all results to syclgen/benchmark_baseline.json with timestamp, model, quantization, batch_size, pp_speed_tokens_per_sec, tg_speed_tokens_per_sec
Capture hardware utilization metrics if available (EU occupancy, memory bandwidth utilization via Intel GPU Tools / ze_tracer)
tasks.success_criteria: Baseline benchmark results saved and reproducible. At least 3 model configurations benchmarked.

tasks.title: Fix sk_001 (MMQ) — Add reqd_sub_group_size(16) and Increase Work-Group Size
tasks.description: The mul_mat_q kernel is missing [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(16)]] which can cause incorrect sub-group sizes on Intel GPUs. Work-group size is 64 (should be 256). These are the most critical fixes for the highest-impact kernel.
actions: Add [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to all MMQ kernel lambdas in mmq.cpp
Increase work-group size from 64 to 256 in the MMQ launch configuration
Verify correctness with existing test suite
Benchmark before/after to measure impact
tasks.success_criteria: Tests pass. Measurable performance improvement on matmul benchmarks.

tasks.title: Fix sk_003 (DMMV) — K-quant Sub-Group Size Mismatch Correctness Fix
tasks.description: CRITICAL: K-quant DMMV kernels use QK_WARP_SIZE=32 but Intel native sub-group is SIMD16. Butterfly reduction pattern extends beyond sub-group width, causing incorrect results for K-quant formats (Q2_K through Q6_K).
actions: Audit all K-quant DMMV kernel reductions for sub-group width assumptions
Replace QK_WARP_SIZE=32 butterfly reductions with proper SIMD16-compatible reductions
Add [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to all DMMV kernel lambdas
Test with K-quant models (Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M, Q6_K) to verify correctness
tasks.success_criteria: K-quant models produce correct outputs. No accuracy regression.

tasks.title: Fix sk_038 (solve_tri) — SLM Overflow Correctness Fix
tasks.description: CRITICAL: MAX_N_SHARED=128 allocates 128*128*4=66KB SLM, exceeding Intel Xe2's 64KB limit. Will cause runtime errors or silent data corruption for N>112.
actions: Reduce MAX_N_SHARED from 128 to 112 (112*112*4 = 50KB, safely within 64KB)
Add oneMKL TRSM fallback path for N > MAX_N_SHARED (matching CUDA's cuBLAS TRSM path)
Test with models that use triangular solve (if available)
tasks.success_criteria: No SLM overflow. Correct results for all matrix sizes.

tasks.title: sk_052 (top_k) — Add Large Vocabulary Support
tasks.description: CRITICAL functional gap: top_k fails with ASSERT for ncols > 1024. Typical LLM vocabularies are 32K-128K. This means top_k sampling may be broken or falling back to CPU for all real models.
actions: Add oneDPL-based sort fallback for ncols > 1024
Implement argsort+copy-first-k strategy using oneDPL sort_by_key
Keep bitonic sort path for ncols <= 1024 (small vocabularies)
Test with 32K and 128K vocabulary sizes
tasks.success_criteria: top_k works correctly for vocab sizes up to 128K. No ASSERT failures.

tasks.title: sk_051 (argsort) — Add Large Vocabulary Support
tasks.description: argsort fails with ASSERT for ncols > 1024. Needed by top_k and sampling. CUDA uses CUB DeviceRadixSort as fallback.
actions: Add oneDPL radix sort or sort_by_key fallback for ncols > 1024
Keep bitonic sort path for ncols <= 1024
Test with various ncols values including 32K, 64K, 128K
tasks.success_criteria: argsort works for arbitrarily large ncols. No ASSERT failures.

tasks.title: sk_006 (MUL_MAT_ID) — Eliminate Blocking D2H Copy
tasks.description: MUL_MAT_ID copies the ids tensor from device to host synchronously, stalling the pipeline. This is the highest-impact single optimization for MoE models (Mixtral, etc.).
actions: Implement GPU-side mm_ids_helper kernel to replace host-side expert counting/routing
Replace ne12==1 serial per-expert path with batched compaction kernel
Eliminate the blocking D2H memcpy of ids tensor
Benchmark with Mixtral-8x7B to measure pipeline stall reduction
tasks.success_criteria: No blocking D2H copies in MUL_MAT_ID path. 30-60% latency reduction for MoE inference.

tasks.title: sk_017 (norm) — Implement Fused RMS_NORM+MUL Kernel
tasks.description: CUDA has fused rms_norm_f32 with do_multiply flag. SYCL requires 2 kernel launches (RMS_NORM + MUL). RMS_NORM is called 2x per transformer layer — fusing saves 1 kernel launch + 1 full read+write pass per call.
actions: Add do_multiply and do_add template parameters to rms_norm kernel
Fuse the element-wise MUL (weight scaling) into the normalization pass
Wire up the fused variant in the op dispatch (detect consecutive RMS_NORM+MUL pattern)
Benchmark with standard LLM models
tasks.success_criteria: Fused RMS_NORM+MUL reduces kernel launches by 1 per layer. 20-40% latency reduction for normalization.

tasks.title: sk_002 (MMVQ) — Increase Work-Group Size and Add SLM Caching
tasks.description: Legacy MMVQ kernels use WG=16 (should be 256). Y vector is read 16x redundantly across sub-groups. Critical for single-token inference (tg) latency.
actions: Increase work-group size from 16 to 256 for legacy (non-reordered) kernels
Implement SLM caching of the shared Y (activation) vector
Add [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to all MMVQ kernel lambdas
Adopt the reordered kernel pattern for all quantization formats
tasks.success_criteria: Measurable speedup on tg (token generation) benchmarks.

tasks.title: sk_015 (softmax) — Compile-Time Specialization and Vectorization
tasks.description: Add compile-time ncols specialization with #pragma unroll (matching CUDA) and vec4 loads/stores. Softmax is called every attention layer.
actions: Add template specialization for common ncols values (32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096)
Add #pragma unroll to inner loops in specialized variants
Implement vec4 loads/stores for the scan and write-back passes
Update SLM threshold from 48KB to 60KB for Xe2
tasks.success_criteria: 10-25% softmax throughput improvement measured in attention benchmarks.

tasks.title: sk_016 (rope) — Implement ROPE+VIEW+SET_ROWS Fusion
tasks.description: CUDA has ROPE+VIEW+SET_ROWS fusion eliminating an intermediate buffer and kernel launch. SYCL lacks this entirely.
actions: Implement fused rope+set_rows kernel variant
Add F32→F16 mixed-precision dispatch needed for fusion
Wire up fusion detection in op dispatch layer
Benchmark on models using rotary embeddings
tasks.success_criteria: 15-30% latency reduction for rope operations.

tasks.title: sk_013 (binbcast) — Vectorization and Fast Integer Division
tasks.description: ADD is the most frequent op in transformer inference (residual connections). vec4 loads and fast_div for 6 integer divisions can yield 10-30% throughput improvement.
actions: Implement vec4 loads/stores for the contiguous-tensor fast path
Replace 6 integer modulo operations with fast_div multiply-shift trick
Increase work-group size from 128 to 256
Benchmark ADD and MUL operations
tasks.success_criteria: 10-30% throughput improvement on ADD/MUL benchmarks.

tasks.title: sk_001 (MMQ) — XMX/joint_matrix Integration
tasks.description: Replace dp4a with joint_matrix (XMX) for 4-8x int8 matmul throughput. Intel Arc Pro B60 has 160 XMX engines capable of 197 INT8 TOPS.
actions: Implement joint_matrix-based MMQ kernel using sycl::ext::oneapi::experimental::matrix
Map the 4-bit quantized weight dequantization + matmul to XMX operations
Start with Q4_0 and Q8_0 formats, then extend to K-quants
Benchmark against dp4a baseline
tasks.success_criteria: 2x+ throughput improvement for matmul on supported formats.

tasks.title: sk_005 (outprod) — Add Batch and GQA Broadcasting Support
tasks.description: Missing batch dimension support (ne2 > 1, ne3 > 1) forces CPU fallback for batched outprod. Missing GQA broadcasting.
actions: Add batch dimension support using oneMKL batched GEMM or strided batched GEMM
Implement GQA head broadcasting in the GEMM wrapper
Add F16 input support
Test with models that use batched outer products
tasks.success_criteria: No CPU fallback for batched outprod. GQA broadcasting working.

tasks.title: sk_019 (cpy) — Implement SLM-Tiled Transpose Kernel
tasks.description: CUDA has SLM-tiled 2D transpose kernel with __shared__[32][33] for coalesced reads+writes. SYCL falls back to generic scalar copy with 4D offset computation (2-5x slower for transpose ops).
actions: Implement cpy_scalar_transpose kernel with SLM tiling (32x33 to avoid bank conflicts)
Detect transpose operations in the dispatch layer
Implement cpy_f32_q and cpy_q_f32 for quantized type support
Benchmark transpose operations
tasks.success_criteria: 2-5x speedup for transpose copy operations.

tasks.title: sk_026 (set_rows) — Add Quantized Destination Types and Fast Division
tasks.description: Missing quantized dst types (Q4_0/Q4_1/Q5_0/Q5_1/Q8_0/IQ4_NL) forces CPU fallback for quantized KV caches. 7 expensive int64 divisions per work-item.
actions: Implement k_set_rows_quant with inline quantization for Q4_0, Q4_1, Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, IQ4_NL
Replace 7 int64 divisions with fast_div_modulo pattern
Add [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]]
Test with quantized KV cache models
tasks.success_criteria: Quantized set_rows works on GPU. No CPU fallback.

tasks.title: sk_033 (ssm_scan) — Add Template Specialization and Native Math
tasks.description: Mamba SSM scan kernel missing compile-time L_template specialization for n_tok=1..8 and #pragma unroll on all inner loops. Uses full-precision exp() where native would suffice.
actions: Add L_template compile-time specialization with switch dispatch for n_tok=1..8
Add #pragma unroll to all inner loops (matching CUDA's 7 unroll directives)
Replace sycl::exp with sycl::native::exp in the hot inner loop
Fix dpct::permute_sub_group_by_xor artifact in warp_reduce_sum
Add [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to Mamba-1 kernel
tasks.success_criteria: 15-30% throughput improvement for Mamba models.

tasks.title: sk_004 (convert) — Standardize Work-Group Sizes and Vectorize
tasks.description: Dequantization kernels have inconsistent WG sizes (16-256), pervasive nd_range<3> DPCT artifacts, missing reqd_sub_group_size on 20+ kernels.
actions: Standardize all dequant kernel WG sizes to 256
Add [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to all 20+ kernel variants
Convert nd_range<3> DPCT artifacts to nd_range<1>
Add vectorized loads/stores (vec4/vec8) where possible
tasks.success_criteria: Consistent kernel configurations. Measurable bandwidth improvement.

tasks.title: sk_034 (cross-entropy-loss) — Increase Work-Group Size
tasks.description: Cross-entropy loss uses WG=WARP_SIZE=16 — only 1 sub-group per WG. With typical vocab 32K-65K, each thread loops 2000-4000 times. WG=256 with block_reduce would reduce per-thread work by 16x.
actions: Increase WG from WARP_SIZE to 256
Add block_reduce pattern for inter-warp reduction
Benchmark training loss computation
tasks.success_criteria: Significantly faster cross-entropy for training workloads.

tasks.title: sk_028/sk_029 (wkv/gla) — Add #pragma unroll and Vectorize SLM Access
tasks.description: WKV and GLA kernels missing #pragma unroll on all loops and using scalar SLM reads where CUDA uses float4 reinterpret-cast for 128-bit vectorized SLM access.
actions: Add #pragma unroll to all inner loops in WKV6, WKV7, and GLA kernels
Implement vec4 SLM reads/writes (reinterpret as float4 for 128-bit access)
Add [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]]
Benchmark with RWKV and GLA models
tasks.success_criteria: 15-30% throughput improvement for RWKV/GLA model inference.

tasks.title: sk_032 (ssm_conv) — Add Template Specialization for d_conv
tasks.description: Missing compile-time template specialization for d_conv={3,4,9}. CUDA uses templates with #pragma unroll for full loop unrolling.
actions: Add template parameter for d_conv with switch dispatch for common values (3, 4, 9)
Add #pragma unroll to the d_conv inner loop
Increase WG from 128 to 256
Add [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]]
tasks.success_criteria: 15-30% throughput improvement for Mamba SSM convolution.

tasks.title: Global — Replace DPCT Artifacts with Native SYCL
tasks.description: Multiple kernels still contain dpct:: artifacts (dpct::permute_sub_group_by_xor, dpct::vectorized_binary, dpct::byte_level_permute). Replace with native SYCL equivalents.
actions: Replace dpct::permute_sub_group_by_xor with sycl::permute_group_by_xor in all kernels
Replace dpct::vectorized_binary with native SYCL operations
Replace dpct::byte_level_permute with SYCL byte extraction
Remove DPCT_COMPATIBILITY_TEMP guards
Audit all SYCL files for remaining dpct:: references
tasks.success_criteria: Zero dpct:: references in the SYCL kernel codebase.

tasks.title: sk_010/sk_013 — Vectorize Element-Wise Operations
tasks.description: Element-wise unary ops and binary broadcast ops are all memory-bound with scalar 1-element-per-work-item processing. Vec4 loads/stores can improve bandwidth 1.5-2x.
actions: Add vec4 fast path for contiguous tensors in unary and binary ops
Detect contiguity at dispatch time and select vectorized vs scalar kernel
Add [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to all element-wise kernels
tasks.success_criteria: 1.5-2x bandwidth utilization improvement for contiguous tensor ops.

tasks.title: Global — Add reqd_sub_group_size to All Remaining Kernels
tasks.description: Many kernels are missing [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]]. This is standard best practice for Intel GPU kernels to ensure correct sub-group sizing.
actions: Audit all SYCL kernel lambdas for missing reqd_sub_group_size
Add [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to all kernels that use sub-group operations or would benefit from fixed sub-group sizing
Convert stream.parallel_for shortcuts to handler.parallel_for where needed to support attributes
Verify correctness after changes
tasks.success_criteria: All kernels have reqd_sub_group_size attribute.

tasks.title: sk_017 (norm) — Reduce GROUP_NORM to 2 Passes
tasks.description: GROUP_NORM currently makes 3 passes where 2 would suffice. Use the float2 accumulator technique from NORM to compute mean and sum-of-squares in a single pass.
actions: Implement float2 accumulator for GROUP_NORM pass 1 (compute sum and sum_sq simultaneously)
Merge mean-subtraction and inv_std-scaling into pass 2
Eliminate pass 3 entirely
Benchmark with diffusion models (Stable Diffusion) that heavily use GROUP_NORM
tasks.success_criteria: GROUP_NORM reduced from 3 passes to 2. 25-33% latency reduction.
